payload.artist_html: S. N. F. Spiekman, C. Browning, M. Tshibalanganda, D. Mukherjee, R. M. H. Smith, A. Du Plessis & F. Wolvaardt
payload.credit_html: "Micro-CT informed cranial anatomy of the early rhynchosaur Howesia browni, with implications for rhynchosaur skull evolution"
payload.description_html: Howesia browni SAM-PK-K10180 in left lateral view. A, photograph. B, μCT-derived reconstruction. Bones are labelled; other relevant morphological structures are marked in bold and underlined. Abbreviations: an, angular; aoc, anguli ori crest; ar, articular; de, dentary; fr, frontal; hy, hyoid; j, jugal; l., left; la, lacrimal; mt, metatarsal; mx, maxilla; na, nasal; nld, naso-lacrimal duct; no, notch; pa, parietal; pal, palatine; pdp, posterodorsal process; pmx, premaxilla; po, postorbital; pof, postfrontal; prf, prefrontal; pt, pterygoid; pvp, posteroventral process; q, quadrate; r, ridge; sq, squamosal; surangular. Scale bar represents 20 mm.
